resources.string: Locally developed attendance tracking for events.
If enabled, a member in the tracker’s expected group may record their own absence as excused. Disabled by default.
Members of these groups and roles may create and manage attendance trackers. Administrators always retain this permission.
No attendance trackers have been configured yet.
Also cancel the event in Admidio
If enabled, marking an event as cancelled in an attendance tracker also changes the cancellation status of the corresponding Admidio event. Disabled by default.
